name: Husqvarna 535i XP
blurb: 14″ bar on .325″ chain, .043″ gauge, 59 drive links, from Husqvarna's 2027 bar and chain fit-up guide.
intro: The 535i XP is a battery rear-handle saw. Husqvarna's Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027) lists 1 bar and chain combinations for the 535i XP: 14″. Pitch on those rows: .325″. Gauge: .043″. Match pitch, gauge and drive links to the bar-tail stamp before you order.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 14″ setup with bar X-Precision 596553659 and chain SP21G X-Cut 596553359.

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027): certified/approved bar and chain combinations, with bar length, pitch, gauge, drive links, file size, bar part and chain part

sources_note: Husqvarna Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide, cover dated 2027, PDF read 5 Nov 2026 (https://media.husqvarnagroup.com/original/DI-328359.pdf). Every row restates that saw's entry in the guide.
